I found some amazing movies with terrible Rotten Tomatoes scores. These movies aren't just underrated, they received embarrassingly low scores from reviewers on Rotten Tomatoes despite featuring stunning visuals, cutting edge filmmaking and side-splitting comedy. For various reasons, these movies just didn't connect with critics but they connected with me and audiences at large.

If you love discovering underrated movies and hidden gems you've never heard of, check back for weekly updates of the best movies to stream and new/old movies to discover.
